newsitem.title: CANADA: Saskatchewan's Romanow names new finance minister.
newsitem.headline: Saskatchewan's Romanow names new finance minister.

text.p: Saskatchewan Premier Roy Romanow appointed a new finance minister in a provincial cabinet shuffle on Friday.
Eric Cline replaces Janice MacKinnon in the finance portfolio, a Saskatchewan government statement said.
MacKinnon was known for bringing down four consecutive balanced budgets with the last, for fiscal 1997/98 (April/March) projecting a surplus of C$24.1 million.
"We will manage surpluses through a balanced approach: building a competitive tax system; reducing the weight of public debt and investing in people," Romanow said.
Saskatchewan is a major producer of oil and gas, grains, potash and uranium.
